phase_name: Interactive Workflow + Publication CLI/Transport Contract Independent Verification
summary: Adversarial independent verification of IWPC-001 v1.0 (docs/contracts/INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_PUBLICATION_CLI_TRANSPORT_CONTRACT.md), Phase 145B's frozen contract. Independently re-derived required CLI architecture, transport boundary, persistence model, authority model, state model, replay model, recovery model, and compatibility guarantees directly from IWC-001 v1.2, PEC-001 v1.1, and direct re-reading of src/pcae/interactive_workflow/** and src/pcae/governance/publication/** -- not from Phase 145A/145B's own summary -- across 22 verification passes. Independently reconfirmed via grep -oE extraction and a Python gap/duplicate check that the requirement set is exactly 191 sequential identifiers (IWPC-REQ-001 through IWPC-REQ-191), zero gaps, zero duplicates, both before and after this phase's own repair. Demonstrated one Blocking finding (B-1): IWPC-REQ-063 (Section 12) and its restatements throughout Section 5 and Sections 16-17 quoted the session-state vocabulary in lowercase snake_case (created, evidence_ready, ...) while asserting this is what the CLI/transport layer reports verbatim from IWC-001; direct re-reading of src/pcae/interactive_workflow/models/session.py's SessionState enum and src/pcae/interactive_workflow/serialization/schema.py's to_payload function shows the real, frozen serialized values are PascalCase (Created, EvidenceReady, AwaitingDecision, AwaitingClarification, DecisionSelected, AwaitingConfirmation, Confirmed, Cancelled, Expired, Abandoned); from_payload performs an exact enum-value lookup that would raise on the lowercase literal IWPC-001 quoted, a direct self-contradiction inside a single frozen requirement. Repaired via an in-place minor version bump (IWPC-001 v1.0 -> v1.1, Section 32 appended), mirroring this repository's established narrow-repair-via-in-place-minor-version-bump precedent (Phase 138C.1, Phase 137M, Phase 143I.1): every affected literal corrected to the exact SessionState value; no state added, removed, merged, or renamed; no transition changed; no requirement renumbered, retired, or reassigned; requirement count independently reconfirmed unchanged at 191. Recorded one additional Non-Blocking, Observation-level finding (C-9: IWPC-REQ-053/186 describe to_payload as an instance method when the actual code is a module-level function) without repairing it. No other Blocking finding was demonstrated across the 22 verification passes. IWPC-001 v1.1 is certified implementation-ready. See docs/PHASE_145C_INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_PUBLICATION_CLI_TRANSPORT_CONTRACT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md and docs/contracts/INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_PUBLICATION_CLI_TRANSPORT_CONTRACT.md (now v1.1).
